details.description: DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B is a 32-billion-parameter dense reasoning model that DeepSeek released in January 2025 alongside DeepSeek-R1, fine-tuning Alibaba's Qwen2.5-32B on about 800,000 reasoning traces generated by DeepSeek-R1. It is the largest Qwen-based checkpoint in DeepSeek's R1 distillation family, transferring R1's chain-of-thought reasoning into a dense model that is cheaper to serve than the full 671B R1. DeepSeek recommends running it without a system prompt at a temperature of 0.5-0.7, and notes it can sometimes skip its own reasoning step. Both the model weights and DeepSeek's code are released under the MIT License.
advantages: Supports a 131,072-token context window, inherited from its Qwen2.5-32B base, per its Hugging Face configuration file.
Scores 94.3% pass@1 on MATH-500, per DeepSeek's Hugging Face model card.
Scores 72.6% pass@1 on AIME 2024, rising to 83.3% with 64-sample consensus voting, per DeepSeek's model card.
Scores 62.1% pass@1 on GPQA Diamond, per DeepSeek's model card.
Scores 57.2% pass@1 on LiveCodeBench, the highest among DeepSeek's Qwen-based R1-distilled models, per DeepSeek's model card.
DeepSeek reports a CodeForces rating of 1691 for this model, per its model card.
disadvantages: DeepSeek's model card says the distilled models can skip their own reasoning step on some queries, which may require forcing the response to start with '<think>\n'.
Text-only reasoning model; its model card documents no vision or tool-use support.
At 32B dense parameters, it needs more memory to serve than the smaller 1.5B, 7B and 14B members of the same distilled family.
use_cases: Chain-of-thought reasoning workloads where serving a dense 32B model is practical.

notes: Catalog's max_input/output tokens (131072) match this model's max_position_embeddings in its Hugging Face config.json, so no discrepancy. No maker source marks this model deprecated or superseded; it remains the largest Qwen-based checkpoint from DeepSeek's January 2025 R1-distillation release.
